prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent 2D game character sprite atlas, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells (16 sprites total).
Primary request: Create SEVERE INJURY poses for all eight existing survivor identities, matching the supplied character references closely. Image 1 reference: four rows are hero (olive jacket and tan trousers, satchel), Lin (woman with two braids, yellow neckerchief, sage overalls), Zhou (elderly gray-bearded repairman, brown cap and leather apron), Chen (short-haired young police trainee, olive clothing, dark scarf, utility belt). Image 2 reference: Xu (woman medic, off-white shirt, medical shoulder bag), Yuan (young man orange jacket, green neckerchief, dark trousers), Meng (stocky middle-aged cook, red headscarf, rust blouse, cream apron, dark skirt), masked hooded visitor (gray ragged hooded cloak). Image 3 reference: use this repaired Meng identity/proportions.
Each identity has TWO adjacent poses: first seated injured pose; second ground-supported crawling/shuffling pose for retreat. Follow this exact grid, row-major: row 1 HERO seated / HERO crawling / LIN seated / LIN crawling; row 2 ZHOU seated / ZHOU crawling / CHEN seated / CHEN crawling; row 3 XU seated / XU crawling / YUAN seated / YUAN crawling; row 4 MENG seated / MENG crawling / HOODED VISITOR seated / HOODED VISITOR crawling.
Seated pose: hips clearly resting ON THE GROUND, both legs bent and visible extending to the lower right, slumped shoulders, head bowed with a pained exhausted expression, one hand braced beside the hip, other hand held to injured abdomen or thigh. Clearly sitting, never kneeling upright, never merely squashing a standing figure. Crawling pose: body low, head bowed, one supporting hand visibly planted on ground, knees bent, moving forward carefully. Whole silhouette stays low, no upright walking. No gore, no bleeding pools, no missing limbs. Tools may rest at the character's hip or in their bag; no raised weapons, no stools, no chairs.
Style/medium: preserve the existing detailed hand-painted watercolor/gouache survivor-game style, fine brown ink contours, warm earthy muted color palette, identical faces, hair, clothes, body proportions, bags/accessories. Three-quarter game view with mild overhead camera, facing RIGHT in all cells. Anatomically coherent hands and arms. Readable miniature silhouettes around 45 pixels tall.
Composition: equal cell boundaries at quarter intervals. Full figure fits inside each cell with at least 10% transparent padding on ALL edges. Consistent scale across poses, all heads similarly sized, the seated figures visibly SHORTER than original standing figures rather than resized larger to fill the cell. Feet and supporting hand share a consistent ground baseline around 85% cell height. Center pelvis at cell horizontal center. No cast shadows.
Constraints: Genuine transparent alpha background. No scenery, no ground texture, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no border, no watermark, no extra characters. Keep sprites fully separated with transparent gutters. Do not include standing characters from the references. This is a NEW sibling asset atlas; do not change the source references.
